description: This Java class, ConceptNumericEditor, extends OpenmrsPropertyEditor to enable serialization and deserialization of ConceptNumeric objects, primarily via ID and UUID, for use within the OpenMRS framework. It interacts with the concept service to retrieve ConceptNumeric objects based on identifier types.

classes.name: ConceptNumericEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for serializing and deserializing ConceptNumeric objects, supporting object retrieval by ID and UUID within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: ConceptNumericEditor
methods.description: Default constructor for the ConceptNumericEditor class.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptNumeric object from the concept service using its integer ID.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptNumeric object from the concept service using its UUID.
